summary: Feed s127_double is degraded: 2 faults detected - VLAN 20 completely missing (50% packets untagged) and NDR port overload (31.30 Gbps burst vs 10 Gbps port, 313% capacity). Both create detection blind spots for this NDR.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker egress is stripping 802.1Q tags or filtering VLAN 20. Required VLAN 20 not seen at all and 50% of packets are untagged, indicating strip-tag enabled or trunk not forwarding VLAN 20 to tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses segmentation context for VLAN 20 and 50% of traffic; cannot apply VLAN-aware detection policies or track lateral movement per segment, creating blind spot despite needing VLANs 10 and 20.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward required VLANs 10 and 20 to restore full segmentation visibility for NDR correlation

findings.root_cause: Aggregated traffic microburst peaked at 31.30 Gbps in a 1ms interval, 313% of the 10 Gbps NDR port capacity. Single 10G tool port is oversubscribed with no load balancing to absorb bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will drop packets during bursts, causing incomplete flows and missed detections; critical as NDR requires both directions and full payload for session reassembly and threat detection.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 3-4 NDR ports with flow-aware 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port utilization <80% and absorb 31 Gbps bursts without drops while preserving flow coherence
